subject: Evidence request: ephemeral token rotation sampling + PR provenance

From: Alex Tan <alex.tan@finsecure.com>

Cc: audit_team@finsecure.com
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request: ephemeral token rotation sampling + PR provenance

Hi Sergio,

As part of our ongoing SIG questionnaire review, our auditors asked for the following artifacts to validate your ephemeral credential controls and PR/merge provenance for releases that touched the inference runtime:

- A representative sample (CSV) of ephemeral token rotation events for Feb 2027 showing token creation time, rotation TTL, user/service principal, and reason (automation/manual).
- CI build IDs and logs for the associated deploys (Feb builds).
- A linkable mapping between PR numbers and final merge commits (or an index) so we can trace code changes to builds.

Can you confirm whether you can provide these items, and if so, an estimated delivery date? Our auditors prefer redacted samples rather than full production logs.

Thanks,
Alex Tan
Senior Auditor, FinSecure Compliance
alex.tan@finsecure.com

Note: please mark any PII/anonymized fields.

Alex / audit team —

Attached are the initial artifacts per Sergio's plan. I've redacted usernames to <team>-svc-### where appropriate and removed session identifiers that could be PII. Items included: 

- rotation-sample-202702.csv (attachment) — 250-line sample from 2027-02-01 to 2027-02-28. Columns: event_ts, token_id (redacted), subject, client_type (service/user), rotation_ttl_seconds, rotated_by (automation/manual), reason_tag. Sample shows automated rotation for infra-service principals at 7200s and manual rotates for support service at 3600s.
- ci-build-report-202702.txt (attachment) — abridged CI job summary (build IDs, timestamps, artifact SHA). Full logs are available upon request under an NDA; this file contains exit codes and duration.
- merge-provenance-index.csv (attachment) — PR# -> merge_commit_sha -> build_id mapping for releases in Feb 2027. We include the internal link path to the PRs in our git host (redacted domain).

Short notes on collection methodology (high level):
- Sampling method: periodically export rotation events from our token-service audit table, applying k-anonymity-style redaction for human IDs.
- Retention: raw rotation events are retained for 90 days in the audit DB; production logs retained per retention policy (see POLICY-LOG-004).
- CI linkage: CI build IDs are recorded in the pipeline metadata and appended to the merge commit via our merge-bot at merge time. The index was generated by correlating pipeline metadata with merge timestamps.

Attachments: [rotation-sample-202702.csv (text/csv)], [ci-build-report-202702.txt (text/plain)], [merge-provenance-index.csv (text/csv)]

If you need an anonymized subset (smaller sample) for review, say 25 rows, I can push that first. Also happy to schedule a quick 20-min walkthrough of the artifacts next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Reliability Engineer, Infra
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
